method: Opened actual LeoCAD views in labelled browser review sheets; examined home composition, front elevation and site plan.
observations: The white dormer and porch form one entrance axis beneath the slate roof.
The tree sits left of the path; the bench and flower box balance the right garden.
revisions: Added a supported dormer to break the large uninterrupted roof.
scope: Exterior composition review; hidden interior interfaces and physical strength are not certified.
